intro: Singapore has about 6 million people of Chinese, Malay, Indian and other origins.

chapters.title: Many cultures
text: About three-quarters of citizens are of Chinese descent, with Malays and Indians the largest minorities. English, Mandarin, Malay and Tamil are all official languages. Singlish is a colourful local English.
Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Taoism and Hinduism are all practised.

chapters.title: Housing
text: About 80% of people live in public housing flats built by the government.
